units: metres; size = Unity axes [x width, y height, z depth]
conventions: Front faces Unity +Z after the 180 deg import turn. Origin at bottom centre (buildings: on the wall centre line). Vertex colour Col: rgb = colour, alpha = tint mask (1 = recolourable).

pieces.name: Awning
